topic: Facility selection logic and analytics discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: the behavior of facility selection in the application, and unexpected traffic data changes in ProVantage clusters.

**Facility Selection:** The current staging environment logic was discussed. On the product version, selecting a master facility highlights only that master. However, on the stage, it highlights both the master and all sub-facilities beneath it, which is confusing. It was agreed that reverting to the previous behavior (product version style) would be better.

**Analytics Data:** Concerns were raised about ProVantage clusters showing unexpected traffic data changes in the analytics dashboard, appearing as if they only started counting yesterday, even though they have been created for a long time. When individual facilities are selected, the traffic is normal; however, when selecting the master facility, all three masters show this discrepancy.
decisions: Revert facility selection logic to previous behavior (product version style)
action_items: Someone needs to address the ProVantage cluster analytics data discrepancies.
